_comment: REL-R1. One table of cases for the title rule of a record. The pytest of acb_common.studio_fields (title_key_of, record_title) and the vitest of packagePreview.ts (titleKeyOf, recordTitle) both read it. A case that differs between the two sides fails one of them. A title of no text is null here, and the client then shows the id.

cases.name: a many text field is skipped
cases.title: Plant

cases.name: no text field falls to the first field
a blank title is no title
a missing title is no title
a first field that is a select
cases.title: open
